Notify.name: Notify Task
Notify.help: Sends a notification when the daily tasks are completed. This is only effective when "Send notification upon daily completion" is enabled in the NKAS settings.

Cadence.name: Run Cadence
Cadence.help: Daily/Weekly/Monthly, managed on the schedule page

ServerUpdate.name: Daily Run Time
ServerUpdate.help: Format HH:mm, multiple times separated by commas, e.g. 04:00, 20:00. Server time (UTC+8); after each run the task is delayed to the next time point

WeeklyDay.name: Weekly Run Day
WeeklyDay.help: 1=Monday, 7=Sunday, multiple days separated by commas, e.g. 2, 5

Serial.name: Serial
Serial.help:
Common emulator serials are listed below. Set to "auto" to auto-detect. If multiple emulators are running or an emulator doesn't support auto-detection, you must set it manually.
Physical device: use the serial shown by adb devices (e.g. 192.168.x.x:5555 for wireless debugging).
Default emulator serials:
- MuMu5.0/MuMu12 127.0.0.1:16384
- LDPlayer emulator-5554 or 127.0.0.1:5555
- BlueStacks 127.0.0.1:5555

PackageName.name: Game Client
PackageName.help: If multiple game clients are installed on the emulator, select the correct one manually

AdbRestart.name: Attempt to restart adb when no device is detected

_info.name: Physical Device
_info.help: Use when connecting to a physical Android device via adb

Enable.name: Enable physical device mode

AutoRestoreResolution.name: Auto restore resolution on stop
AutoRestoreResolution.help: When enabled: stopping the instance automatically restores the native resolution and screen orientation; when disabled, restore manually with the buttons below

VirtualDisplay.name: Run game on a virtual display (recommended)
VirtualDisplay.help: Create a 720x1280@240dpi display inside Android and capture it directly without changing the physical screen; recommended. The same implementation works on Windows, Linux, and ARM Linux; the host only needs ADB. When enabled, the screenshot and control method settings are ignored: frames are captured from the virtual display and control always uses ADB.

WebUrl.name: ws-scrcpy URL
WebUrl.help: Used by the interactive mode of the screen preview on the overview page (click and drag to control the game). Example: https://scrcpy.example.com. Leave empty to disable interactive mode. See the Wiki for deployment and usage: https://nkas.megumiss.top/wiki/#/en/Interactive-Control

Bitrate.name: Video bitrate
Bitrate.help: Initial video bitrate (bps) for interactive mode connections, default 16000000. Higher bitrate means sharper image and more bandwidth

MaxFps.name: Video frame rate
MaxFps.help: Initial frame rate cap for interactive mode connections, default 60

_info.name: Emulator Settings
_info.help: Values below are auto-filled based on Serial. Do not modify unless you know what you're doing.

Screens.name: Multi-Screen Mode
Screens.help: When enabled, supports running the game window on secondary or virtual displays. You will also need to manually select the target screen for the game window.

ScreenNumber.name: Game Window Target Screen
ScreenNumber.help: Select the screen that meets the resolution requirements. The default is 0 (main screen). You must enable Multi-Screen Mode first. After selection, the game window will move to the corresponding screen. The screen order may differ from the system display settings.

VddScreen.name: Target Screen Is VDD Virtual Display
VddScreen.help: Enable when the target screen is a VDD (Virtual Display Driver) virtual display. Select the target screen while the virtual display is enabled.

VddAutoManage.name: Auto-Manage VDD Screen
VddAutoManage.help: Requires 'Target Screen Is VDD Virtual Display' to be enabled. When enabled, the virtual display is automatically enabled when a task starts and disabled after it finishes.

GameWindowPosition.name: Game Window Position
GameWindowPosition.help: Set the game window position to prevent it from being obscured or off-screen

GameResolutionCompat.name: Game Resolution Compatibility Mode
GameResolutionCompat.help: Enable if script reports incorrect game resolution or logs show window resolution not equal to 720x1280

ScreenRotate.name: Rotate Screen
ScreenRotate.help: Recommended for 1080p users only. When enabled, the screen will switch to portrait on start to meet vertical resolution requirements; it will revert to landscape after tasks finish or by pressing Ctrl+F12

CloseAutoHdr.name: Disable Auto HDR
CloseAutoHdr.help: NKAS may not work properly on systems with HDR enabled. If system HDR is on, enable this option to disable the game's auto-HDR (system-wide HDR remains unaffected)

DisableVoice.name: Disable Voice
DisableVoice.help: Automatically mute the game process while the script is running and restore it after completion. If it does not restore automatically, you will need to re-enable it manually in the system volume mixer on the taskbar.

Client.name: Game Client
Client.help: Launcher and game title/process will be auto-filled based on selected client. Clear related launcher/game title/process settings before switching.

AutoFillName.name: Auto Fill Fields
AutoFillName.help: Automatically fills in the launcher and game title and process information

LauncherPath.name: Launcher Path
LauncherPath.help: Game launcher path. Required. Located in the Launcher directory under the game installation path. Example: E:\NIKKE\Launcher\nikke_launcher.exe

LauncherTitleName.name: Launcher Title
LauncherTitleName.help: Launcher window title; usually no manual input required

LauncherProcessName.name: Launcher Process
LauncherProcessName.help: Launcher process name; usually no manual input required

GamePath.name: Game Path
GamePath.help: Game path; located in the NIKKE\game directory under the game installation path. Usually auto-filled based on launcher path. Manually change if auto-filled path is incorrect

GameTitleName.name: Game Title
GameTitleName.help: Game window title; usually no manual input required

GameProcessName.name: Game Process
GameProcessName.help: Game process name; usually no manual input required

ScreenshotMethod.name: Screenshot Method
ScreenshotMethod.help:
pyautogui: best compatibility and stability, but slower and affected by occlusion.
mss: fastest, but affected by occlusion.
PrintWindow: slightly slower than mss, not affected by occlusion, compatibility may be slightly worse.

ControlScheme.name: Control Scheme (BETA)
ControlScheme.help:
pyautogui: a perfect foreground mode; simulates physical mouse input, and clicks, scrolling, and swipes occupy the real mouse.
postmessage: an imperfect background mode; clicks, scrolling, swipes, and ordinary keyboard presses are sent as window messages with brief real-cursor movement, and do not bring the game window to the foreground. Select PrintWindow as the screenshot method to avoid occluded captures. When keyboard input is needed, the game is briefly brought to the foreground, then the previous foreground window is restored. The launcher still requires foreground input.

AutoRedCircle.name: Auto-click red circles during battle
AutoRedCircle.help: Requires enabling sync-click position and crosshair. Currently supports Interception, Tower, Simulation Room, Solo Raid, Union Raid, Coop, etc. Accuracy is low; circles outside the screen cannot be handled

OcrModelType.name: OCR Model Selection
OcrModelType.help: Mobile model (default): fast, slightly lower accuracy; Server model: larger, slower, slightly more accurate

OcrThreads.name: OCR Threads
OcrThreads.help: CPU threads used by PaddleOCR inference. Set to 1 on ARM64 devices if crashes occur

ScriptPath.name: Script to run after queue clears
ScriptPath.help: Relative path of the script file. Windows supports .bat/.ps1/.exe; Linux supports .sh. Relative paths are based on the script's root directory. Preset scripts are located in scripts\windows.For example, if you want to lock the screen after execution, you can enter: scripts\windows\lock.bat.

RetentionDays.name: Log Retention Days
RetentionDays.help: Automatically cleans run logs and error log directories older than this many days. Set to 0 to disable auto cleanup.

ScreenshotPath.name: Recruit Screenshot Path
ScreenshotPath.help: Gacha screenshots will be saved in the specified path. Leave blank to disable saving. For example: D:\PCR\NIKKE. Docker users must specify a folder starting with /app/NIKKEAutoScript.

OnlyToCompleteDailyMission.name: Only complete daily missions, exit after entry

priority.name: Purchase Priority
priority.help: If empty, only free items will be bought. Items are bought in priority order.

AutoFillCodeManual.name: Auto Fill Code Manuals
AutoFillCodeManual.help: Automatically fills Arena Shop purchase priority from the latest warehouse counts for the five code manuals. Run Warehouse Stats first.

CodeManualBuyThreshold.name: Code Manual Buy Threshold
CodeManualBuyThreshold.help: Code manuals below this count are added to Arena Shop priority, sorted by shortage descending.

priority.name: Purchase Priority
priority.help: If empty, nothing will be purchased. Items are bought in priority order.

priority.name: Core Purchase Priority
priority.help: If empty, gems and core dust cases will be bought by default. Items are bought in priority order.

bonePriority.name: Bone Purchase Priority
bonePriority.help: Bone currency purchase priority. If empty, nothing will be purchased.

WhenDailyTaskCompleted.name: Send notification when daily tasks complete

WhenDailyTaskCrashed.name: Send notification when daily tasks crash

WinOnePush.name: Win extra push
WinOnePush.help: When enabled on Windows, send an extra OnePush notification

OnePushConfig.name: Push Settings
OnePushConfig.help:
Use Onepush to send an error message. Configuration: https://github.com/LmeSzinc/AzurLaneAutoScript/wiki/Onepush-configuration-%5BCN%5D
Change the provider value in config from gocqhttp to onebot11 to enable onebot support. 
Currently only smtp and onebot11 support image sending, such as error screenshots and gacha screenshots.

SendGift.name: Send Gift
SendGift.help: Give the first NIKKE with incomplete affinity a lowest-rarity affection coupon

EnhanceEquipment.name: Enhance Equipment
EnhanceEquipment.help: Enhance a random equipment in inventory, consuming one Module Booster (blue) or Module Advanced Enhancer (purple)

CallReward.name: Repeat Collect
CallReward.help: Run collect once more before claiming daily mission rewards

Enable.name: Enable
Enable.help: When enabled, collectibles will be auto-switched according to settings below

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.help: NIKKE priority. If the selected collectibles exceed 160, the current one is removed from the list and the next is chosen.

CheckInterval.name: Check Interval
CheckInterval.help: Check current rank once every X minutes, and send a notification when rank changes

Enable.name: Enable this feature
Enable.help: When enabled, choose opponents by weight and strategy; when disabled, choose the bottom opponent

SortingWeight.name: Sorting Weight
SortingWeight.help: JSON string format. Weights must sum to 1. Set others to 0 to disable. Keys: Power, CommanderLevel, SynchroLevel, Ranking

_info.name: Conversation
_info.help: Automatically choose the correct dialog options with near-100% accuracy(Only zh-CN)

OnlyLogsNotMax.name: Only converse when logs are not full
OnlyLogsNotMax.help: Only converse with NIKKE whose conversation logs are under 20. Recommend enabling 'Only converse with favorites' as well

Cookie.name: Cookie
Cookie.help: Recommended: click the "One-click login" button above to obtain and fill in automatically. For other methods, see: https://nkas.megumiss.top/wiki/#/en/Configuration-Guide?id=_9-nikke-community-site

XCommonParams.name: XCommonParams
XCommonParams.help: The x-common-params parameter in the request header must include the openid. Filled in automatically by "One-click login"; under normal circumstances, no updates are required.

AutoRenew.name: Auto Renew (BETA)
AutoRenew.help: Automatically renews the cookie shortly before it expires. An expired cookie cannot be renewed, so keep tasks running regularly; if it expires, click "One-click login" above to obtain a new one. Depends on playwright and a browser; the first renewal automatically installs playwright, and Docker users will also download chromium.

_info.name: Daily Tasks
_info.help: Community daily sign-in, comment, and like tasks https://www.blablalink.com

Immediately.name: Execute Immediately
Immediately.help: By default, tasks scheduled between 4:00–8:00 are postponed to after 8:00. Enable to execute immediately

_info.name: CDK Auto Redemption
_info.help: By default, redeem CDKs recommended on BlaBlaLink

Extra.name: Extra CDK Sources
Extra.help: Fetch the latest 5 CDKs from third-party sites and redeem automatically

Priority.name: Exchange Priority
Priority.help: If empty, the default priority (gems only) is used. Items are exchanged in priority order.

AutoPush.name: Auto Push (BETA)
AutoPush.help: Automatically clears event stages and skips cutscenes. Tries to support all stages; the script will stop if a stage is unsupported.

AutoFormation.name: Auto Formation
AutoFormation.help: Please ensure you have enough Nikkes for a 100% bonus and sufficient combat power.

HardTicket.name: Buy Hard Mode Tickets
HardTicket.help: When Hard Mode is open, automatically purchase all attempts/tickets before starting the run.

Sweep.name: Stage Sweep
Sweep.help: Performs Quick Battle on the second-to-last stage. Requires having cleared that stage manually first. Ensure your stage progress matches the current event unlock schedule.

Challenge.name: Challenge
Challenge.help: Requires teams to be set up in advance

Shop.name: Shop
Shop.help: Attempt to buy all event currency items except titles in order (may not always work)

ShopDelayList.name: Shop Delay Purchase List
ShopDelayList.help: Items in this list will be purchased only after obtaining red orbs. One per line. Currently only supports delaying TITLE purchases

Game.name: Mini Game
Game.help: Adapt mini-games when possible; otherwise skip

GameTenBeam.name: Mini-Game Search Strength
GameTenBeam.help: The solver's search range. Higher values yield slightly better solutions but require more computation time.

GameTargetScore.name: Mini-game Target Score
GameTargetScore.help: Only effective when mini-game looping is enabled. The loop will stop once the target score is reached.

Enable.name: Enable Strategy
Enable.help: Choose which side to cheer based on strategy and current support ratios

AchieveLevel.name: Achieve Level
AchieveLevel.help: Quick battle will only start when the cleared stage reaches the selected stage below. Recognition may be inaccurate, please adjust according to your situation.

QuickBattleOnly.name: Quick Battle Only
QuickBattleOnly.help: Only performs quick battles. When quick battle is unavailable, it will automatically skip. Suitable for users who manually play Interception on Mondays.

DropScreenshotPath.name: Drop Screenshot Path
DropScreenshotPath.help: Creates dated folders under the path to save drop screenshots. Empty to disable. Example: D:\\PCR\\NIKKE. Docker users should use a path starting with /app/NIKKEAutoScript

_info.name: Rotation Settings
_info.help: When enabled, selects the BOSS by day after the server 04:00 reset.

Enable.name: Enable Daily Rotation
Enable.help: When enabled, ignores the BOSS setting above and selects the BOSS from the weekday settings below.

_info.name: Team Settings
_info.help: Automatically select team based on chosen BOSS

SkipRatioCheck.name: Ignore Top Record
SkipRatioCheck.help: Recommended to keep off. When on, overclock top record won't be checked and it will run daily

AlwaysReselect.name: Always Reselect Options
AlwaysReselect.help: Always reselect based on list below. If off, selection occurs only at season start

ModifierList.name: Overclock Options
ModifierList.help:
Supports common overclock options only:
ENEMY_WEAPON_UP_1/2/3: Enemy Weapon Up I/II/III
ENEMY_ARMOR_UP_1/2/3: Enemy Armor Up I/II/III
ENEMY_VITALS_UP_1/2/3: Enemy Vitals Up I/II/III
NO_RECYCLING: Disable Recycling
AGGRESSIVE_TACTICS: Aggressive Tactics
RUSH_HOUR_1/2/3: Rush Hour I/II/III
RELEVANT_PERSONNEL_ONLY: Relevant Personnel Only
Default selection is Enemy Weapon Up III, Enemy Armor Up III, Enemy Vitals Up III, Disable Recycling, Aggressive Tactics, Rush Hour III, Relevant Personnel Only (total 25x). Fill one per line. Reduce options if your collection strength is insufficient.
If the top record shown on the overclock page is equal to or higher than the total multiplier entered below, overclock will be skipped

_info.name: Auto Tower
_info.help: Automatically climb normal tribe tower; stop on failure

_info.name: Semi-Auto Click
_info.help: Semi-automatic clicks to skip some interactions. Can auto-click battle, quick fight, skip story, next stage, area transfer. Requires manual stage selection and team setup in advance

FightQuickly.name: Quick Battle
FightQuickly.help: Disable when using tickets in stages

MainStoryMark.name: Auto Follow Main Story
MainStoryMark.help: When enabled, auto-click main story normal difficulty exclamation marks and hide minimap. May auto-progress main story but is unstable and will miss enemies 100%

CDK.name: CDK
CDK.help: Paste the CDKs into the input box, one per line. After the prompt says the settings have been saved successfully, click Start to redeem.

_info.name: Highlights
_info.help: Auto-view highlights. Start on NIKKE's gift/conversation page

AutoSwitch.name: Auto Switch
AutoSwitch.help: When a NIKKE's highlights are complete, auto-switch to next. Stop with F10

Orientation.name: Orientation
Orientation.help: Manually change screen orientation; recommend Ctrl+F12

Hosts.name: Hosts
Hosts.help: Append uncommented entries below to system Hosts file (Windows only). International servers enabled by default. Uncomment desired servers. It's recommended to only enable hosts for your server and adjust as needed.

_info.name: Setting
_info.help: May be unstable. For first-time use, it is recommended to move squads 1, 2, and 3 back to the base and ensure no missions are already active.

AutoPlace.name: Automatic squad deployment
AutoPlace.help: Automatically deploys squads 1, 2, and 3 to mission points. When disabled, squads must be manually moved to the mission locations.

CsvPath.name: CSV Path
CsvPath.help: CSV output path for inventory stats

_info.name: Item List
_info.help: Show the latest item statistics result. The result may be inaccurate.

_info.name: Interception Drop Stats
_info.help: Hidden settings for interception drop statistics

CsvPath.name: Stats CSV Path
CsvPath.help: CSV path for interception stone drops

_info.name: Interception Stone Charts
_info.help: Daily, weekly, and monthly charts generated from interception drop records

ImportHistory.name: Import History Screenshots
ImportHistory.help: Recognize stone drops from historical interception screenshots and import into CSV

_info.name: Account Setting
_info.help: Only LiPass accounts are supported for automatic login.

Account.name: Account
Account.help: Paste your email here. It will be auto-filled if login expires. This feature has security risks; use with caution.

Password.name: Password
Password.help: Paste your password here. It will be auto-filled if login expires. This feature has security risks; use with caution.

_info.name: Task Status
_info.help: Stores internal task states. Can be cleared manually if tasks behave abnormally

Toast.DisableTranslateMode: Click here to disable translation mode
Toast.ClickToUpdate: Update available — click here to update
Toast.AutoUpdated: Auto-updated to {sha} ({count} commits). Click for details

AddNKAS.FileExist: A config with the same name exists. Please enter a different name
AddNKAS.InvalidChar: Config name cannot contain any of the following characters: .\\/:*?"<>|

AppManage.NameExist: A config with the same name exists. Please enter a different name
AppManage.InvalidChar: Config name cannot contain any of the following characters: .\\/:*?"<>|
AppManage.OverrideWarning: This will overwrite the existing config file
AppManage.Name: Config Name

Update.UpdateWait: Wait for all NKAS to finish current tasks
Update.UpdateFailed: Update failed. See ./log/*_gui.txt for error logs
Update.Author: Author
Update.DisabledWarn: Update module is disabled; you need to manually restart NKAS to update

Remote.NotRunning: Not running — disconnected from server or server offline
Remote.NotEnable: Not enabled. Set webui password in deploy.yaml and enable remote control
Remote.SSHNotInstall: SSH not installed on system. Refer to guide to install or download SSH

Text.InterceptionImportPathPlaceholder: Defaults to Interception screenshot path, editable
Text.InterceptionImportFailed: Import failed. Please check path and screenshots.
